---
name: Suggest an idea
about: Something you would like Spoken Margins to do, or do differently
labels: needs-triage-review
---

**What you want to do.** What you are trying to get done as a listener, in your own words.

**What gets in the way today.** What you do now, or why it falls short.

**How you imagine it.** If you have a picture of it, describe it. This part is optional; the first two matter more.

**Anything else.** Links, screenshots or other apps that do this well.
